title: Core
description: The save, plugin list, game data loading, the crash log, small game tweaks and limit breakers (booster packs from packs.json, 256 user deck slots). Always on.

settings.title: Engine rules 2020
settings.help: Duel rules: on = the game's own 2020 rules (Master Rule 5), off = 2019 rules (Master Rule 4). Core sets the engine's rules byte when the game starts, so restart after changing it.

settings.title: Duel format
settings.help: Duel format for offline duels, using the rules built into the game's duel engine. speed = Speed Duel: 4000 LP, 4-card hand, 3 monster and 3 spell/trap zones, no draw on the first turn, no Main Phase 2. rush = Rush Duel: 8000 LP, draw until you hold 5, unlimited Normal Summons, 3 + 3 zones and no Extra Monster Zones, no Main Phase 2, no chains. The field still shows 5 zones; Skills and Maximum monsters are not in the engine. Online duels use the host's Duel format row on the match settings screen (Yu-Gi-Oh-MP) instead. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Min Main Deck
settings.help: Fewest Main Deck cards a deck may have (1 to 60). Speed Duel decks are 20 to 30. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Main Deck
settings.help: Most Main Deck cards a deck may have (MinMainDeck to 60; a deck holds at most 60). Decks over the limit can't be picked for a duel until cards are taken out. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Extra Deck
settings.help: Most Extra Deck cards the deck editor lets you add (0 to 15; Speed Duel uses 5). The game only checks the Main Deck's size, so a deck that already has more stays usable. Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Max Side Deck
settings.help: Most Side Deck cards the deck editor lets you add (0 to 15). Restart after changing it.

settings.title: Plugins path
settings.help: The loader's Plugins folder, e.g. <repo>\Binaries\Debug\Plugins\. The Effects plugin reads its files from a folder named Effects inside it. Must end with a backslash.

settings.title: Seed from game save
settings.help: The first time savegame-ex.dat is created, copy your Steam save into it so your progress carries over.

settings.title: Game save name
settings.help: File name of the save the game always uses (Yu-Gi-Oh-Core is always loaded). Your original savegame.dat is never touched.

settings.title: Save slot
settings.help: 0 = after the title screen, pick a save slot on the save-select screen. 1 to 5 = always load that slot and skip the screen. Slot 1 is the GameSaveName file, slot N the same name with -N (savegame-ex-2.dat); names and avatars are in Yu-Gi-Oh-Ex\saves.json.

settings.title: Archive
settings.help: Name of the game's .toc/.dat archive pair the game opens.

settings.title: Allow multi instance
settings.help: Allow more than one copy of the game to run at once.

settings.title: Loose loading
settings.help: Load files from a folder next to the game (FolderName) instead of the archive's, so extracted or modified files win (see FileOrder for WolfX's patch).

settings.title: Patch archive
settings.help: WolfX's patch archive (<name>.toc / .dat next to YGO_2020.dat): the game's files WolfX changed. Core loads them over the game's own archive whenever they exist, which is never written. Empty = off (the game's own data only). WolfX saves into the same name.

settings.title: File order
settings.help: Which copy of a game file wins when both exist: loose = a loose file (LooseLoading, FolderName) wins over WolfX's patch archive; patch = WolfX's patch wins. Either way the game's own YGO_2020.dat comes last. WolfX follows the same setting.

settings.title: Pause in background
settings.help: Pause the game when its window loses focus (off = it keeps running).

settings.title: Japanese version
settings.help: Act as the Japanese release of the game (its logo and Japanese-only text layouts).

settings.title: Mod settings
settings.help: Let switched-on mods set plugin settings from their own Config.ini (Mods\<mod>\Config.ini), so a mod works without you editing yours. A mod's value wins over yours while the mod is on. Off = only your Config.ini is read.
